lines.text: The Teacher, son of David, king in Jerusalem, says everything is futile and asks what a man gains from labor.
Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.
The sun rises and sets and hurries back to where it rises, while the wind blows eastward, then turns northward.
All rivers flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full, and the eye is not satisfied with seeing.
What has been will be again, nothing is new under heaven, and those before us are not remembered.
